title: fix(editor): Apply color styles to selected shapes
body: Describe what your pull request does. If you can, add GIFs or images showing the before and after of your change. ## What was broken Selected shapes ignored color changes from the style panel. In the live examples app, clicking red or light-blue left a selected rectangle at `color: black`. ## Root cause `Editor.setStyleForSelectedShapes` returned early for `tldraw:color`. The style panel called the right editor command, but the command skipped selected-shape color updates before building the shape updates. ## Fix Remove the color-only early return so color uses the same selected-shape style update path as fill, dash, size, font, and other styles. ### Change type - [x] `bugfix` - [ ] `improvement` - [ ] `feature` - [ ] `api` - [ ] `other` ## Test `packages/tldraw`: `yarn test run -t "should set style for selected shapes"` now passes. It asserts that `setStyleForSelectedShapes(DefaultColorStyle, 'red')` changes selected geo shapes to red. Also ran `yarn typecheck` from the repo root. ### Test plan 1. Create a rectangle in the examples app. 2. Select the rectangle and set fill to solid. 3. Change the style-panel color to red, then light-blue. 4. Confirm the selected shape changes to each color. - [x] Unit tests - [ ] End to end tests ## Evidence Before: After: ### Release notes - Fixed a bug where selected shapes ignored color changes from the style panel.
